audit: Phase 3.5A -- reproduction / corrected diagnostic / future methodology (amended in Checkpoint F)
how_to_read: Three sections that must never be blended. (1) is what the frozen v1 pipeline reported and is preserved verbatim. (2) is a diagnostic measured AFTER the fact and does not restate v1's methodology. (3) is what v2+ will use.

section_1_historical_frozen_v1_as_report.note: Original methodology, unchanged: discontinuity flags built from the whole target season (D9), tau/cap tuned on the trailing-PPG control (D10), residual target actual - trailing PPG (D7). The 'vs Sleeper' row used the Sleeper run's own tuned gate (tau .5, cap .08), not the served gate.
section_1_historical_frozen_v1_as_report.discrepancy_classification: SOURCE_REVISION / DEPENDENCY_DRIFT (nflverse + FI caches re-fetched between 2026-09-08 and 2026-09-16). No leakage introduced, no model defect. The frozen model is NOT updated for floating-point / source drift.

section_2_corrected_diagnostic.note: Diagnostic ONLY. Frozen v1 coefficients (from start_sit_model.json, not retrained) evaluated at the gate v1 actually serves (tau 3, cap .25) against the production-like Sleeper baseline. It does not certify or re-tune anything and is not v1's original claim.
section_2_corrected_diagnostic.reading: Removing the leakage changes the diagnostic by ~1% (-10,852 -> -10,718 pts). D9 was an integrity defect that would have contaminated any future candidate, but it did NOT manufacture v1's conclusion. The betas were still trained on leaked features, so this is not a re-certification. Against the production-like baseline the served gate remains a net loser at every position (46.4%-49.5% reversal win rate); it looks useful only against the naive control.

section_3_future_candidate_methodology_v.control: TRAILING_PPG -- reported at the SAME served gate; never selects or certifies
section_3_future_candidate_methodology_v.gate_identity: (tau, cap) selected on production pairs from earlier eligible weeks; evaluated with the IDENTICAL (tau, cap) on later held-out weeks; tau=0 (never reverse) always available; asserted by assert_gate_identity()
section_3_future_candidate_methodology_v.status: DORMANT. No v2 fit, no artifact. reevaluate.R evaluates the gate only, fails closed, never promotes.
